setup: [a text from an unknown number greets someone by a name that is not the player's, as if it were meant for a friend or a client] [told it is the wrong number, the sender apologises warmly and keeps the chat going with small talk and a compliment]
ask: [a few friendly messages later the sender mentions how well an investment app or a crypto plan has gone for them, offers to show the player how it works, and suggests a small first deposit]
usualEnding: The app shows growing profits and a small early withdrawal works, then larger deposits are asked for and a fee blocks every withdrawal after that.
realTwin: A real person who texted the wrong number says sorry, says they will check the number with their friend, and does not write again.

source.url: JAPAC_WhatsApp_Viber_Scam_Catalogue_Expanded.pdf (entry 35); https://www.scamshield.gov.sg/i-want-protection-from-scams/learn-to-recognise-scams/investment-scams/ (updated 2 Jun 2026: investments recommended by online friends or strangers, small profits first, then no withdrawals).
